rationale: Phase-4 PHASE-A item A3: honest SOURCE-ONLY re-measure of the two mutation targets whose `path` historically included a nested tests/ subtree (mutmut's default tests-dir guess only excludes a top-level tests/, so the nested tools/testkit/{code_verification/mms,property}/tests/ subtrees were being mutated and skewing the kill rate). mutmut-config.toml now carries `exclude = "tests"` for both targets (passed as `mutmut --paths-to-exclude tests`). Both scores remain BELOW the 0.80 advisory floor and are recorded HONESTLY — NOT widened. The mutation gate stays SOFT_WARN everywhere (spec § 2.13, Phase-4 A3 honesty correction); HARD_FAIL-at-landing is an earned future promotion once a target's own constraining tests lift its source-only kill rate to the floor. See docs/_audits/phase-4/pre-dispatch-review-2026-05-30T17-54-54Z.md.

targets.delta_note: source-only DROPPED vs tests-included (0.265 -> 0.2243): the prior figure was partly INFLATED by killed test-file mutants. The dominant residual dilutant is source the mms/tests/ runner does not exercise (solutions/{incompressible_ns_2d,reaction_diffusion_2d,reaction_diffusion_3d} are driven by other sims' runners, not by mms/tests/). NOT widened.

source-only ROSE vs tests-included (0.2034 -> 0.3455, +0.14): here the nested tests/ subtree was genuinely diluting (surviving test-file mutants). The residual shortfall is source the property/tests/ runner does not exercise (sims/*/invariants.py + invariants/ are driven by per-sim package tests, not by property/tests/). NOT widened.
